title: The Scope Grammar of Natural-Language Rules: Counting and Enumerating Readings modulo Logical Equivalence
abstract: arXiv:2611.01825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A rule written for people fixes its atomic conditions and connectives but leaves open how the connectives are bracketed, and each bracketing is a different logical reading that an autoformalizer must resolve or expose. We study the scope grammar, a deliberately ambiguous context-free grammar whose derivation trees are the readings of a connective skeleton and whose quotient by logical equivalence is what matters downstream. A skeleton with $k$ binary connectives has $C_k$ derivation trees, the $k$-th Catalan number, but far fewer logically distinct readings. For the positive, repetition-free fragment we make the gap exact: through the uniqueness of the read-once normal form we characterize the realizable normal forms by lowest common ancestors and count them with a two-label recurrence over the operator word, verified against exhaustive enumeration up to eleven atoms. translated_title: 自然语言规则的作用域文法：模逻辑等价的读法计数与枚举
translated_abstract: 为人类编写的规则确定了其原子条件和连接词，但并未明确连接词应如何加括号，而每一种加括号方式都对应一种不同的逻辑读法，自动形式化器必须解决或揭示这些读法。我们研究了“作用域文法”，这是一种刻意保持歧义的上下文无关文法，其推导树即为连接词骨架的各种读法，而对其按逻辑等价取商后的结果才是下游应用真正关心的内容。一个含有 k 个二元连接词的骨架拥有 C_k 棵推导树（即第 k 个卡塔兰数），但逻辑上不同的读法数量却少得多。对于无重复原子的正片段，我们精确刻画了这一差距：借助读一次范式的唯一性，我们用最低公共祖先刻画了可实现的范式，并通过在算子词上的双标记递推对读法进行计数，其结果与最多十一个原子的穷举枚举相验证。该计数在反转和 ∧/∨ 对偶下保持不变。
tldr: 该论文提出“作用域文法”来刻画自然语言规则中连接词作用域的歧义性，通过读一次范式与双标记递推，精确计数并枚举了连接词骨架在模逻辑等价意义下逻辑上不同的读法数量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "scope grammar" to capture connective scope ambiguity in natural-language rules, and precisely counts and enumerates the logically distinct readings of a connective skeleton modulo logical equivalence via read-once normal forms and a two-label recurrence.
